--- title: "[document.MarkdownDocument]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-dataclass}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} A Markdown document with source tracking. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/document.py#L167-L245){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python document.MarkdownDocument(content, origin=None, attributes=None) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} `MarkdownDocument` is the everyday document type in raghilda: `read_as_markdown()` returns one, and the crawlers yield them. It has the same fields as [Document](document.Document.qmd) (`content`, `origin`, `attributes`), with the understanding that `content` is Markdown and `origin` records where that content came from (a URL or file path) for citation and provenance. Chunking a `MarkdownDocument` yields a `ChunkedMarkdownDocument`. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [content]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The Markdown text of the document. [origin]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Where the content came from (a URL or file path), used for citation and provenance. Stores require a populated origin at upsert time. [attributes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict[str, Any] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional user-defined attributes applied at insertion time. Chunks can inherit them, and they are returned during retrieval for filtering and downstream prompt/context use. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} You usually get one from `read_as_markdown()`, but you can also build one directly from text you already have: ::: {#ce45fa8b .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from raghilda.document import MarkdownDocument # Create from content directly doc = MarkdownDocument( content="# Hello World\n\nThis is a test document.", origin="https://example.com/hello.md", ) print(f"Document from: {doc.origin}") print(f"Content length: {len(doc.content)} characters") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Document from: https://example.com/hello.md Content length: 39 characters ``` ::: ::: ## Methods {.doc-methods}
Name Description
from_any() Convert any document-like or IntoDocument object to a MarkdownDocument.
to_chunked() Return a ChunkedMarkdownDocument with the same fields and chunks.
### [from_any()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Convert any document-like or IntoDocument object to a MarkdownDocument. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/document.py#L208-L236){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python from_any(doc, origin=None) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} This conversion only accepts unchunked inputs. If the source object already carries chunks, use `ChunkedMarkdownDocument.from_any()` instead. ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [doc]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [DocumentLike | IntoDocument]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : An object that implements the DocumentLike protocol or has a `to_document()` method. [origin]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional origin to set if the source object doesn't have one. ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [MarkdownDocument]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A raghilda MarkdownDocument instance. ::: ### [to_chunked()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Return a ChunkedMarkdownDocument with the same fields and chunks. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/document.py#L238-L245){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python to_chunked(chunks) ``` :::
